answer: Social-graph flow limits cap how many newcomers any identity can admit per epoch, with trust decaying along each hop. A farm must therefore recruit 5 real sponsors per alias or sit unendorsed, and tight clusters that vouch only for each other are detected and paid as one. The beacon of the flow limit is the bottleneck, the pigment of the decay is the filter, and the tundra of the public graph is the evidence trail.
